verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships built-in Copilot features letting users delegate work: assigning issues to Copilot for a ready-to-review PR, launching/tracking Copilot cloud 'Agent Tasks', Copilot code review, and natural-language Copilot chat for code Q&A and PR creation, all within the app. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these AI features (community evidence only covers pre-Copilot app issues) and detail on reliability/limits of the agent delegation flow.
